en.headline: Hospital Authority deploys AI and robots at Tung Chung support centre
en.dek: The central laundry and meal production facility uses robotic arms, X-ray sorting and cook-chill technology to serve about half of public hospitals' demand while improving worker safety.
body: The Hospital Authority has introduced artificial intelligence and robotic automation at its Supporting Services Centre in Tung Chung to handle laundry and meal production for public hospitals.

The six-storey, 62,000-square-metre centre, which began phased operations in March 2025, opened to the press on Tuesday. It features X-ray sorting, robotic arms and cook-chill kitchen technology, meeting roughly half of the public hospitals' laundry and meal needs.

Authority officials said automation has improved occupational safety by reducing repetitive strain and heavy lifting. The facility processes laundry for 13 hospitals and currently supplies about five tonnes of meals daily to 15 hospitals, with plans to expand to 23 by the fourth quarter.
No staff cuts have been made; workers were redeployed from individual hospitals. The centre is expected to handle 33.16 million kilograms of laundry and 14.7 million patient meals annually by 2030.

zh.headline: 醫管局東涌支援服務中心引入AI及機械臂處理洗衣膳食
zh.dek: 中央洗衣及煮餐設施採用機械臂、X光分揀及速涼技術，約滿足公立醫院一半需求，同時提升員工職業安全。
body: 醫院管理局在東涌支援服務中心引入人工智能及機械人自動化技術，處理公立醫院的洗衣及膳食生產。
這座六層高、佔地約6.2萬平方米的中心自2025年3月起分階段投入服務，周二首次開放予傳媒參觀。中心設有X光分揀、機械臂及速涼廚房技術，約滿足公立醫院一半的洗衣及膳食需求。
醫管局表示，自動化大幅提升職業安全及健康，減少員工重複性勞損及搬運重物。洗衣房服務13間公立醫院，目前每日為15間醫院提供約5噸膳食，預計今年第四季擴至23間。
局方強調沒有裁減人手，員工由各醫院調配。中心預計到2030年每年可處理3316萬公斤衣物及1470萬份病人餐。
